answer: The anchor test I would run is proof of unique electrician registration with trade body attestation: a registration the trade body renews against inspected work, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the whisper compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The kernel grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
